decisions.rationale: The clean pinned server permits official_sha256 null and emits that nullable template, while the candidate rejects the result after already writing a nominal successor. It also requires the continuation to reuse predecessor plan/permission references, directly contradicting separate per-call authorization. A localized template-key/value and ordering correction restores a required route without widening authority.
decisions.smallest_fix: Validate and retain the exact research response field set before normal-result publication, allow pinned nullable/default values, remove predecessor plan/permission equality, and rely on the continuation call's own fresh validated plan, permission, decision, and authorization artifacts.
